title: festuca ovina var. rubra
intro: Festuca ovina var. rubra, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a variety of grass belonging to the Poaceae family, known for its vibrant red or reddish-brown foliage and its ability to thrive in a wide range of environments. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in promoting relaxation and soothing the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue include sedative, nervine, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and essential oils, such as coumarins and sesquiterpenes, which have been identified in its roots, leaves, and flowers.
